h1: PVC window welding and corner cleaning machines — single-head, double-head and 4-corner welders, CNC corner cleaners
intro: A PVC (vinyl) window frame is joined by welding: the mitred profile ends are pressed against a heated plate until they melt, then pushed together and held while the seam cools; the bead of melted plastic left on the corner is cleaned off afterwards. NovoTech supplies the welders and corner cleaners of Plastmak, built in Bursa, Turkey: the SÇ 101 single-head welder for any angle from 25° to 180°; the SÇ 100 double-head welder for profiles 13-3/8″ to 126″ long; the SÇ 100 Gold Plus, which welds all four corners of a frame up to 145-11/16 × 106-5/16″ at once, and the Gold Plus Full line that adds a robot and a CNC cleaner; the SÇ 601 corner cleaner with three knives; and the SÇ 6000 and SÇ 6000S CNC corner cleaners. All three welders can make a 0.2 mm (.008″) seam. Supplied with a CSA-approved panel, installed and supported from Mississauga, ON, Canada.

groups.title: Corner cleaning machines
groups.lead: They take the weld bead off the corners, faces and seal grooves after welding.

faq.q: How does a PVC welder work?
faq.a: The two mitred profiles are clamped and pressed against a Teflon-covered heating plate until their ends melt; the plate is withdrawn and the ends are pressed together and held while the joint cools — welding, cooling and temperature set for each profile type. A 0.2 mm seam limits the weld bead to 0.2 mm (.008″), so laminated and coloured profiles need little or no cleaning.

The single-head SÇ 101 welds one corner at a time — four cycles a frame, any angle, the right start for small shops and arched windows. The double-head SÇ 100 welds two corners at once, and the SÇ 100 Gold Plus all four, so a frame is welded in one cycle and comes out square. The Gold Plus Full carries the frame on to a CNC cleaner by robot, with no operator in between.

Welding leaves a bead of melted PVC on the faces and in the gasket grooves of every corner; left on, it stops gaskets and hardware from seating and looks poor. The SÇ 601 cleans the corner and faces with knives in one PLC cycle; the CNC cleaners also clean seal grooves, radii and laminated profiles — the SÇ 6000S with 10 tools and automatic profile recognition.

faq.q: What frame sizes fit the 4-corner welder?
faq.a: Frames from 16-1/8 × 19-1/2″ (410 × 495 mm) up to 145-11/16 × 106-5/16″ (3,700 × 2,700 mm), with profiles 1-9/16″ to 7-7/8″ high and up to 5-7/8″ wide. With the gasket press option the range is 20-1/2 × 20-1/2″ to 143-11/16 × 104-5/16″.

faq.q: What voltage do these machines run on?
faq.a: Three-phase machines are supplied for 600 V as standard with a CSA-approved panel; 208 V, 240 V and 480 V 3-phase are available on request, and 240 V single-phase on models with a small enough motor. Manual machines have no electrics.
